mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for August 20, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. State-backed Israeli settler violence forces West Bank displacement: HRW. HRW calls for sanctions and suspension of military aid as dozens of Palestinian communities are at risk of erasure. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. Israel's Ben-Gvir posts video of gallows site for hanging Palestinians. Israel's far-right national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, who has attracted international sanctions and condemnation for his activities, has posted a gloating video of the construction of the site of a gallows where Palestinians convicted of terror offences, but not Jewish extremists accused of similar crimes, will be hanged. This was reported by The Guardian. 3. Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation. The five-year-old Palestinian girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives. This was reported by BBC News. 4.
